bank.title: The Oil Rig That Swallowed an Entire Lake
bank.question: How did a small drilling error drain an entire lake into a salt mine?
bank.hook: A tiny drill hole swallowed an entire lake.
bank.payoff: A miscalculation caused a drill to puncture a salt mine underneath, creating a whirlpool that sucked in the entire lake.
bank.why_visual: A giant whirlpool in a shallow lake sucking down barges and trees like a bathtub drain.
visual_metaphors: a lake being sucked through a tiny straw
a salt shaker turning into a giant vacuum
bank.critic_note: The Lake Peigneur disaster offers the strongest visual potential, though the 'oil rig' was actually a small drilling barge.
